### 🔥 Grill Management
1. **Zone the Grill**:  
   Set up two zones—one hot (direct heat) for searing and one medium-low (indirect heat) for keeping items warm. Rotate food as it’s ready so nothing burns and nothing cools down.
2. **Cook in Batches**:  
   Grill burgers, chicken, and veggies in groups. Slide finished items to the cooler side, tent with foil, and let them rest while you cook the next batch. This keeps everything hot and juicy.

   Keep an instant-read thermometer handy. Pull chicken at 165°F, burgers at 160°F, and veggies when tender. This prevents overcooking and keeps food safe.
